preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only lowercase letters a-z.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: The pattern p contains only lowercase letters a-z and the special characters '?' and '*'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (fnmatch.fnmatch(s, p) if '*' in p else re.fullmatch(re.escape(p), s))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if the entire input string s matches the pattern p, otherwise False.
